clinicIntro.title: Welcome to HealStride
clinicIntro.desc: Hello, I'm Dr. MD Rashid, Senior Consultant Physiotherapist | MPT (Sports) at HealStride Physiotherapy & Wellness Centre. With 5+ years of clinical experience and over 2,500 happy patients, we are dedicated to helping patients overcome pain, recover mobility, and restore peak performance through evidence-based treatments. Certified in Cupping Therapy, Dry Needling Therapy, Taping Therapy, Mulligan’s Mobilization with Movement (MWM), and Basic Life Support (BLS) & Critical Care Management. At HealStride, we combine modern technology, specialized care, and personalized rehabilitation plans for faster recovery.
